title: iris pallida subsp. cucullata
intro: Iris pallida subsp. cucullata, commonly known as the Dalmatian iris, is a plant species within the iris family (Iridaceae) and is native to the Dalmatia region in the Adriatic coast. The health benefits of Iris pallida subsp. cucullata include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues, making it a useful remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome and eczema. Bioactive constituents of Iris pallida subsp. cucullata include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
